text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has come to the seaside
summer camp along with the
other Tracen
Academy students.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, to train right after waking up each
day—it doesn't get any
better than this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is a valuable opportunity,
and I intend to make the
most of it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you're here with me. Let's get to
work. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, our summer training camp begins...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... I cannot seem to... run at my best...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm going to run one more lap...
I'm not yet satisfied... with my
results...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem to be reaching the goals
she's set for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But at this point, her form seems to be
worsening from exhaustion.
Any more and
she's likely to get injured...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I'm fine... I can still run...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I... have to train—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then I'll head back to my
room. Good day, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking it much better than I thought she
would, Grass Wonder heads
back to the
lodge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'd heard there's a summer festival
nearby,
so I came to invite you.
Would you like to
join me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought she'd be frustrated about not
training more, but she seems
like her usual
calm self.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Heehee,
festivals are a staple of summer in
Japan, so we can get an
appreciation for
the culture there.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I find quiet places more desirable for
taking walks, but festivals have
their own
unique, vibrant mood.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look at this. They have whole candied
watermelons. I trust you
haven't spoiled
your appetite?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
that was merely in jest. We can still
have fun without getting
carried away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we wander around the many stalls,
Grass Wonder suddenly stops in
front of
the shooting gallery.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look at that kitty plushie. It's
adorable.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text:
You've a good eye, miss. Care to test your
skills?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You know what... Trainer, I'm going to try
for it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The normally peaceful Grass Wonder holds
a rifle at the ready. I'm so
engrossed at the
unusual sight when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pew! Dink...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I did it! In a single shot, no less. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text: What a hit! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ...Now then, I still have some
shots left.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pew! Dink... Pew! Dink...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my, look at all these stuffed toys.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm blown away. You got every prize in
one go... You some kinda
hitman?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm nothing so sinister.
I simply have a
steady hand, thanks to the
inner harmony I
maintain. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What fun we had at the festival. ♪ Even at
training camp, it's vital to
relax sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, a part of me would, yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As you know,
I don't like to yield or relent,
so I've no intention of
compromising on my
goals.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I'm only able to be so stubborn
because I have a trainer like you
to
support me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who insists that I
stop
when I truly need to stop.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And I'll always run with all my heart. So,
be it summer camp or
whatever lies ahead,
you have my complete trust.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I decide to respond to Grass
Wonder's dedication by giving her a brand
new training scheme that works the entire
body
instead of just her legs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I've finished the long-distance
swimming.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see you've incorporated some water
training to keep the impact off
my legs.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But... wait. Was that the last set? How
strange—I still have plenty of
energy to
run.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you make a mistake with the
schedule?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"To speak without words"... You always
understand me better than
anyone,
hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I want to help Grass Wonder be her
best, it looks like I'll need some

extraordinary speed of my own to keep
up.
